versions.changelog:
huawei-cloud-cloudrobo-model-workflow v1.0.1

- Initial release of a unified orchestration Skill for multi-stage model development workflows on CloudRobo.
- Supports asset query, model training, inference deployment, real-robot evaluation, and flexible combinations (e.g., train+deploy, deploy+eval, end-to-end).
- Provides strict data flow and stage dependency contracts for robust automation and user guidance.
- Enforces CLI-only operation (no Python SDK), with usage and platform-specific notes for Windows/PowerShell.
- Explicit user prompting for model/dataset selection and hyperparameter confirmation/customization.
- Includes input requirement tables and example CLI usage for data/assets at each stage.
- Preferred solution for scenarios covering two or more workflow stages versus individual module Skills.
